title: Kagamine Rin — The Arrogant Princess〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You there, many have suffered at my hands...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Those who did not know their place and those who refused to obey paid the highest price.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I justified it all as part of maintaining power and order within my borders.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Despite how egotistical I was, despite how wasteful I was, despite how many I made suffer, no one dared speak out against me.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I am the one they call, “The Daughter of Evil”...
Do it...!
Riliane's Room

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: How dare they talk back to me in such a manner...!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Consider how the people feel. Bah!
Straight out of Leonhart's mouth!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Hmph... They are but a fool.
A mere noble biting the hand that feeds it.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only I could be rid of Leonhart so easily...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: And despite their insolence, they are one of Lucifenia's Three Heroes...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, teatime.
Your Highness, your tea has arrived.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Ah, Allen! You may enter!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Pardon me, your Highness.
Today, I have brought you brioche.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Shall I pour you some tea now?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: You shall!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Oh, Allen!
Where were you this morning?

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Th-This morning?
I was cleaning the great fountain and garden, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I was hoping that you would see magnificent work!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Ah, the others have already told me about that. Justice has been served, I take it?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Indeed it has!
But I was simply fulfilling my sovereign duties...

rows.Speaker: Chamberlain's Voice
rows.Line: Ahhh...!! Oh no...!!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Ah, that must be Chartette.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I believe so...
Please excuse me, your Highness. I must attend to this matter at once...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: You are excused. Go.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Thank you, your Highness!
Oh, please be careful with the tea. It's still very hot.

rows.Speaker: Allen's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
What have you done, Chartette...?

rows.Speaker: Chamberlain's Voice
rows.Line: What do you mean?! I was just trying to clean the windows...!!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: How cute...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Allen's Voice
rows.Line: Your Highness, I have arrived.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Enter.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Your Highness...?
Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: As sharp as ever, I see!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
You must hear this, Allen!
That blasted Leonhart...!!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: He is demanding that the larder be opened to the public to help relieve this famine! Can he not see that I am suffering as well?!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: You know as well, yes? How he has been smuggling food out of the royal larder.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Yes, I am aware...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: He may be the Captain of the Royal Guard, but that does not give him the right to defy me as such...!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Hmph... No matter. This will be the last time he draws my ire...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Um, your Highness, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Allen, take this...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: A small bottle with a piece of parchment inside...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Take it out and read it.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Yes, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Surprised? I suppose anyone would be.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Leonhart is one of the Three Heroes, and very beloved at that...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Because of this, unlike with my other vassals, I lack the political capital to punish him for his actions.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Regardless, if I cannot pass judgment through official means, there is always another way.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Your sword will come in handy here.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: No, I would not stand a chance against the likes of Leonhart, one of the famed Three Heroes...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Fear not, for I have a plan.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: He has a soft spot for drinks, does he not? If we use that to our advantage...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Then, I will feign accepting his demands and show that we are no longer at odds with one another!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: We will prepare some wine for him that is to be laced with a paralytic, which he will surely drink to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: This plan is also to be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Understood, your Highness...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I was so naive back then...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: During the famine, my beloved mare would usually end up eating better than my people.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I left the dirty work to others and relished in the fact that all would go my way no matter what happened.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: In time, my deeds would go beyond my borders.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Word eventually reach me that my betrothed was stolen away by another wench, and it would drive me mad with jealousy.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I felt compelled to hunt down and punish not only the thief in question, but all women with the same green hair. After that...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh? Is somebody there...?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: They must have heard...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: No matter. I am not finished repenting.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Please, stay a while and listen to my story...
